search.label: Search for a place
search.placeholder: Search a place or paste coordinates

hint.drag: Drag to look around, scroll to zoom

map.label: Map
map.note: Click the map or drag the pin to move the viewpoint.

controls.rangeHelp: How far the horizon is computed.
controls.eyeHelp: Above the ground. Use a tower or summit height to look from there.
controls.refractionHelp: 0.13 is the usual average. 0 gives pure geometry.
controls.noEvent: The sun does not do that on this date here

peaks.title: Visible peaks
peaks.empty: No named peaks in view yet.

los.intro: Click the map to place a target. The check uses the same terrain, earth curvature and refraction as the panorama.
los.pick: No target yet. Click the map.
los.clearBy: The sight line clears the terrain by {meters} at {at}.
los.blockedBy: Terrain rises {meters} above the sight line at {at}.
los.open: Nothing lies between the two points.
los.targetHeightHelp: Zero checks the ground itself. A peak target uses its summit.
los.chart: Terrain profile between the viewpoint and the target

status.peaksFailed: Peak names could not be loaded. The terrain is still real.
status.noGeo: This browser has no location service
status.peaksBundled: OpenStreetMap is busy, so these names come from the bundled list of notable peaks.
status.peaksOffline: You are offline, so these names come from the bundled list of notable peaks.
status.compassOn: Turn your phone to look around. Touch the view to stop.
status.noCompass: This device has no compass sensor

terrain.title: The terrain could not be loaded
terrain.body: The elevation tiles did not arrive ({reason}). Check your connection and try again.

footer.data: Terrain: AWS Terrain Tiles. Peaks and map: OpenStreetMap.

photo.intro: Drop a photo of a skyline. I trace the ridge, match it to the terrain and label the peaks. Nothing is uploaded.
photo.drop: Choose a photo or drop it here
photo.dropHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP. GPS and heading in the file are used when present.
photo.canvasLabel: Your photo with the matched terrain outline and peak labels
photo.needsLocation: This photo has no GPS position. Click the map to say where it was taken.
photo.waiting: Waiting for the terrain around the photo...
photo.matched: Matched. The mean gap between the ridge and the terrain is {gap} degrees.
photo.weak: Weak match, mean gap {gap} degrees. Check the position on the map or nudge the sliders.
photo.unreadable: This file could not be read as an image
photo.heading: Heading
photo.credit: WhichPeak, terrain from AWS Terrain Tiles
